the Metahara Irrigations Scheme is a good example of a gravity irrigation scheme with high irrigation efficiency.

water distribution, delivery and management in large scale irrigation schemes are often not well understood by scheme managers.
water distribution, delivery and management in gravity irrigation schemes is a complex hydrodynamics process.
